Typing test passages from Standard Ebooks
Licence: the books are in the public domain; the Standard Ebooks editions
are dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0 (see LICENSE.txt).
Source: https://standardebooks.org (single-page HTML of each ebook,
downloaded November 2026)

passages.json holds about the first 1,150 to 1,270 words of a chapter of
eight books, from where the chapter starts, for the typing test page
(/typing-test/):

  pride-and-prejudice   Jane Austen, Pride and Prejudice (1813), chapter 1 and
                        the start of chapter 2
      https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/jane-austen/pride-and-prejudice
  a-christmas-carol     Charles Dickens, A Christmas Carol (1843), stave 1
      https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/charles-dickens/a-christmas-carol
  moby-dick             Herman Melville, Moby-Dick (1851), chapter 1
      https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/herman-melville/moby-dick
  alice                 Lewis Carroll, Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
                        (1865), chapter 1
      https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/lewis-carroll/alices-adventures-in-wonderland/john-tenniel
  sherlock-holmes       Arthur Conan Doyle, The Adventures of Sherlock
                        Holmes (1892), A Scandal in Bohemia
      https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/arthur-conan-doyle/the-adventures-of-sherlock-holmes
  the-time-machine      H. G. Wells, The Time Machine (1895), chapter 1
      https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/h-g-wells/the-time-machine
  the-call-of-the-wild  Jack London, The Call of the Wild (1903), chapter 1
      https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/jack-london/the-call-of-the-wild
  the-great-gatsby      F. Scott Fitzgerald, The Great Gatsby (1925),
                        chapter 1
      https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/f-scott-fitzgerald/the-great-gatsby

Changes made to the text: whole paragraphs from the start of the section,
joined with single spaces (headings, footnote markers and illustrations
left out); curly quotation marks and apostrophes replaced by straight
ones; an em dash by a hyphen with a space on each side (or no space next
to a quotation mark); an en dash by a hyphen; an ellipsis character by
three full stops. Nothing else was changed.
